name: Awais Shafique
headline: CEO & Founder @ Beyond Presence | Founder & CPO @ Presize (Meta) | Forbes 30U30 | CDTM
summary:
Our team at Beyond Presence pioneers in leveraging AI for building the future of human interaction, a journey I embarked on after a successful tenure at Meta. Here, I spearheaded initiatives connecting fashion brands with global audiences through innovative social commerce platforms. My Master's degree in Biomedical Computing and an Honours in Technology Management, both fuel my drive for tech-driven solutions.

Previously, as Co-Founder and CPO of Presize, our collective vision and execution led to breakthroughs in accurate body measurements, enhancing e-commerce efficiency and sustainability. This venture's growth, culminating in acquisition by Meta, is testament to our team's dedication to transformative AI applications in the fashion industry.

Size recommendations for Fashion eCommerce people trust (higher conversion) & keep (less returns & CO2).

positions.title: Deep Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Design & development of pioneering Deep Learning and statistical models applied to personalized digital medicine and predictive healthcare problems. Data collection, preparation and analysis for model training. Experimental research on Machine Learning algorithms for time series classification task.

Technologies: python, deep learning, pytorch, neural networks, computer vision, opencv, human pose estimation, machine learning, sklearn, time series, data preparation, git

For more than a half of a year at Kaia I took part in 4 projects working on smartphone camera-based pose estimation and human actions recognition tasks, diseases prediction problem, digital marketing users analysis topic. These projects are industrial and directly used in Kaia software products.

My main contribution was the development of Deep learning models to predict the UPDRS score for a Parkinson's patient from a series of smartphone-based tests.

In our main project at Kaia, we have established the state of the art deep convolution network based on Human Pose Estimation techniques for supervising patients physical exercises and giving suggestions on how to perform the exercises better, just like a physiotherapist would do. This approach is currently ready for use and is available as a standalone iOS application.

company.description:
Beyond Presence builds the next generation of real-time AI avatars: hyper-real, multilingual, and emotionally expressive. 

We are a research company building foundational models for Hyper-realistic, real-time interactive avatars that can have human-like face-to-face conversations.

Powered by our proprietary foundational model, our avatars don’t just talk, they listen, react, and respond in under 100ms, making every interaction feel natural, human, and personal.

From customer support and sales enablement to HR interviewing, training, coaching, and immersive experiences, our API-ready platform lets you embed lifelike AI into your products without compromise.

Why settle for static chatbots or delayed video rendering when you can deliver live, face-to-face AI conversations that build trust, drive engagement, and scale globally?

We combine:

1) Human connection – expressive avatars with natural micro-expressions, tone, and empathy.
2) Machine precision – 24/7 availability, multilingual fluency, and instant scalability.

🚀 Use Cases:

1) AI customer support agents that resolve issues instantly.
2) Sales avatars that pitch, demo, and close — in any language.
3) HR interviewer avatars that screen and assess candidates with consistency and fairness.
4) Virtual trainers and coaches that adapt to each learner.
5) Digital humans that bring games, virtual worlds, and events to life.

🤝 Let’s build it together → https://www.beyondpresence.ai/
